answer: Start with Proof of unique phone model via attestation. The idea is simple: a model attested by the manufacturer, and that zephyr alone separates one real agent from a hundred fakes. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since a model attested by the manufacturer takes calendar time as well as money — and the reef is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. Time is the tax here: a model attested by the manufacturer cannot be rushed or parallelised beyond a point, so the opal for a farm is a calendar it cannot buy its way out of.
